name: metrx
description: Manage the AI agents your company employs: workforce review, job contracts, bill checks. Sign in with your Metrx account.

interface.shortDescription: Review the AI agents your company employs.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to your Metrx organisation over OAuth. Ask for the workforce review, an agent's scorecard or job contract, a vendor bill check, or record a decision on an agent. You sign in with your Metrx account; no API key is copied anywhere.
defaultPrompt: Show me this period's workforce review.
